quizName:
DMV Practice Test  #22
										  					
  

25 Questions • Passing Score 20

questions.question: What should you do when you see a steady yellow arrow at a traffic signal?

options.text: Merge into the lane in the direction of the arrow.
Slow down and stop if you can do so safely.
Turn left after checking for oncoming cars and pedestrians.
Go through because you have the right-of-way and oncoming traffic must stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and stop if you can do so safely.
questions.explanation: A steady yellow arrow means a red arrow is coming next. Stop unless you are already in the intersection.

questions.question: What should you do when driving in bad weather?

options.text: Drive faster to reach your destination quickly.
Follow the car ahead more closely.
Stay farther behind the car ahead of you.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay farther behind the car ahead of you.
questions.explanation: On wet roads, increase the space between your car and the car in front of you.

questions.question: What does it mean when a solid white line on the road's right edge slants toward the center?

options.text: An intersection is ahead.
A construction area is ahead.
You must turn left soon.
The road becomes narrower.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road becomes narrower.
questions.explanation: A solid line along the road's edge marks where the road ends. When this line angles toward the center, the road is getting narrower ahead.

questions.question: How should you always think of railroad crossings?

options.text: Safe to cross because trains rarely come.
Dangerous.
A safe place to park your car.
A place where you must always stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: Dangerous.
questions.explanation: Railroad crossings are always dangerous. Always look and listen for trains from both directions. Follow all signs, signals, and instructions from flaggers. Never cross until you are sure it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No right turns allowed.
Right turns are permitted.
Stop before turning right.
Sharp curve ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turns allowed.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red line through it means something is not allowed. This sign means right turns are prohibited.

questions.question: When parking downhill on a two-way street, which way should you turn your wheels?

options.text: Turn them to the right.
Turn them to the left.
Keep them straight.
Leave your transmission in neutral.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn them to the right.
questions.explanation: When parked on a downhill slope, turn your wheels sharply toward the side of the road. If your car rolls, it will roll away from traffic.

questions.question: Your accelerator pedal is stuck while driving on a busy street. What should you do?

options.text: Honk your horn.
Press hard on the brakes.
Turn on your four-way flashers.
Turn off the ignition carefully without locking the steering wheel.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn off the ignition carefully without locking the steering wheel.
questions.explanation: If the accelerator sticks, turn off the ignition carefully by moving it only far enough to stop the engine without locking the steering wheel. Then apply the brakes and move to a safe area off the road.

questions.question: What is the best way to stay safe when backing up your vehicle?

options.text: Honk your horn just before shifting into reverse.
Walk behind the vehicle to check for obstacles before getting in.
Check your rearview mirrors.
Turn up the radio to alert people nearby.

questions.correctAnswerText: Walk behind the vehicle to check for obstacles before getting in.
questions.explanation: It is hard to see behind your vehicle. Before backing up, walk to the back and check for children and small objects.

questions.question: When driving on slippery roads, what should you do?

options.text: Always drive at the speed limit.
Use cruise control to keep a steady speed.
Follow the car ahead more closely.
Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid sudden changes in speed or direction.
questions.explanation: Do not make sudden changes in speed or direction on slippery roads. Slow down and do not use cruise control.

questions.question: You are driving on a highway with two solid yellow lines dividing it. When may you cross these lines?

options.text: Only to turn left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway.
To pass other vehicles if there is no oncoming traffic.
Never.
Only to make a U-turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Only to turn left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway.
questions.explanation: Double solid yellow lines mean no passing from either direction. You may cross these lines only to turn left into or from an alley, private road, or driveway.

questions.question: What does a solid white line down the center of a two-lane road mean?

options.text: Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in opposite directions. Passing is allowed when safe.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is not allowed.
Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is allowed when safe.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic moves in the same direction. Passing is not allowed.
questions.explanation: White lines separate traffic moving in the same direction. A solid white line means you cannot pass.

questions.question: What does a broken yellow line next to a solid yellow line mean?

options.text: Passing is allowed from both directions.
Passing is allowed from the lane with the broken line.
Passing is allowed from the lane with the solid line.
Passing is not allowed from either direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Passing is allowed from the lane with the broken line.
questions.explanation: A broken yellow line means you can pass from that lane. A solid yellow line means you cannot pass from that lane.

questions.question: Highway signs that require drivers to follow an instruction are called:

options.text: Regulatory signs.
Warning signs.
Information signs.
Guide signs.

questions.correctAnswerText: Regulatory signs.
questions.explanation: Regulatory signs tell you what you must or must not do. You can be fined for not following them.

questions.question: What do diagonal stripes sloping down and to the left on a barricade mean?

options.text: Stop.
Turn right.
Turn left.
Drive straight.

questions.correctAnswerText: Turn left.
questions.explanation: Diagonal stripes on a barricade show which way to go. Stripes sloping down to the left mean turn left. Stripes sloping down to the right mean turn right.

questions.question: If you are behind a school bus or tank truck, you should:

options.text: Pass them on the right.
Be ready to stop at railroad crossings.
Follow closer to them.
Honk your horn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Be ready to stop at railroad crossings.
questions.explanation: School buses and tank trucks must stop at all railroad crossings. Be prepared to stop if you follow one of these vehicles.

questions.question: When should you pull over for an emergency vehicle?

options.text: No matter which direction it is coming from.
Only if it is behind you.
Only if it is coming toward you.
None of the above.

questions.correctAnswerText: No matter which direction it is coming from.
questions.explanation: Pull over to the right and stop for any emergency vehicle with flashing lights, whether it is coming from behind or from the opposite direction.

questions.question: You cannot park within _____ of a fire hydrant.

options.text: 10 feet
25 feet
50 feet
100 feet

questions.correctAnswerText: 10 feet
questions.explanation: You may not park within 10 feet of a fire hydrant.

questions.question: At a stop sign, you should stop and:

options.text: Check your rearview mirror for cars behind you.
Move when the car ahead moves.
Look right, then left, then right again.
Look left, then right, then left again.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look left, then right, then left again.
questions.explanation: Look left first because vehicles from the left are closer to you. Then look right, then left again to catch any vehicles you may have missed.

questions.question: When entering a highway from an entrance ramp, you should generally:

options.text: Drive faster than traffic to get ahead.
Drive slowly to avoid other cars.
Stop first, then slowly enter.
Speed up to match the traffic speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Speed up to match the traffic speed.
questions.explanation: Use the acceleration lane to speed up. Signal, look for an opening, match the traffic speed, and merge into an open space.

questions.question: An intersection is blocked by traffic ahead. What should you do?

options.text: Go slowly until traffic ahead moves.
Get as close as possible to the car in front.
Stay out of the intersection until it is clear.
Honk your horn to make cars move.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay out of the intersection until it is clear.
questions.explanation: Do not enter the intersection if you cannot get completely through it. Wait until traffic clears so you do not block the intersection.

questions.question: If there are two railroad tracks next to each other, what should you do?

options.text: It is always safe to cross after one train passes.
You must always stop before crossing the tracks.
After one train passes, check the other track for a second train before crossing.
Honk your horn as you cross the tracks.

questions.correctAnswerText: After one train passes, check the other track for a second train before crossing.
questions.explanation: When two railroad tracks are next to each other, a second train may be coming on the other track. Wait until you are sure no train is approaching on either track before you cross.

questions.question: What is the maximum speed limit on a paved divided highway unless a different speed limit is posted?

options.text: 25 mph
40 mph
55 mph
70 mph

questions.correctAnswerText: 70 mph
questions.explanation: The maximum speed limit on a paved divided highway is 70 miles per hour. Always follow posted speed limits if they are different.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Stop
Side road
Two-way left turn
Farm machinery

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean stop. You must stop and give the right-of-way to other traffic. You can go when it is safe.

questions.question: When can you cross a solid yellow line?

options.text: To pass traffic moving in the same direction
During daylight hours only
At any time
When making turns

questions.correctAnswerText: When making turns
questions.explanation: You can cross broken yellow lines, but not solid yellow lines. The only time you can cross a solid yellow line is when you are turning.

questions.question: A traffic light turns from green to solid yellow as you approach an intersection. What should you do?

options.text: Treat it as a caution sign and keep going through the intersection
Stop right away
Stop before entering the intersection, unless stopping is not safe
Speed up to cross before the red light appears

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop before entering the intersection, unless stopping is not safe
questions.explanation: When a yellow light appears, try to stop before entering the intersection if you can do so safely. If you cannot stop safely, drive carefully through the intersection.
